subject.title: [Feature]:  For version 2026.7.1, request to improve the documentation, as the current documentation is difficult to understand in conjunction with the product.

question: Should classic onboarding support completing installation without verified inference, or should LAN-only users be directed to the existing custom-provider and baseline/non-interactive paths?
rationale: The guided flow intentionally verifies inference before starting OpenClaw, while classic and scripted setup expose alternative paths; changing that contract requires deciding whether offline completion is a supported interactive workflow.

options.title: Document Offline Paths
options.body: Keep the guided verification gate and add a precise LAN-only recipe covering classic custom providers, baseline setup, and scripted skip flags.

options.title: Add Classic Completion Skip
options.body: Allow classic onboarding to write the remaining configuration and finish without a verified model, with clear warnings and regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Document Offline Paths
recommendation.body: Keep the guided verification gate and add a precise LAN-only recipe covering classic custom providers, baseline setup, and scripted skip flags.

likelyOwner.reason: Their v2026.7.1 work introduced the onboarding mode boundary at the center of this decision.
